研究問題 1：電輔車和一般車的旅次特徵是否顯著不同？哪些特徵最能區分兩者？

```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path.cwd().parent if Path.cwd().name == "notebooks" else Path.cwd()
trips = pd.read_parquet(ROOT / "data" / "processed" / "trips.parquet")
SEED = 42
```

## 分層抽樣

```{python}
# 每種車種抽相同數量，避免一般車主導結果
sample = (
    trips.dropna(subset=["distance_km", "speed_kmh"])
    .groupby("bike_type", group_keys=False)
    .sample(n=5000, random_state=SEED)
)
features = ["distance_km", "duration_min", "speed_kmh", "hour"]
```

## 描述統計

```{python}
sample.groupby("bike_type")[features].describe().T
```

## 假設檢定

TODO：多變量常態（Mardia 檢定）、共變異數同質（Box's M）。

## MANOVA

```{python}
from statsmodels.multivariate.manova import MANOVA

manova = MANOVA.from_formula(
    "distance_km + duration_min + speed_kmh + hour ~ bike_type", data=sample
)
print(manova.mv_test())
```
